captions.detailed: A hydraulic dropper seatpost featuring a dark, matte-finished cylindrical outer tube clamped by a metallic silver seat-tube binder ring, with a small silver hydraulic port fitting on its lower side. A silver-anodized inner post extends vertically from the outer tube on a prismatic slider joint. At the top of the inner post, a single-bolt saddle rail clamp head connects to two parallel curved steel cradle rails via a revolute tilt-adjust pivot, supporting a padded black bicycle saddle shell.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric hydraulic dropper seatpost assembly with a black outer tube, a silver inner sliding post, a lower hydraulic port, a seat-tube clamp, and a bicycle saddle mounted to a tilt-adjustable rail clamp head.
captions.factory: Construct the outer tube and inner sliding post using concentric cylinders, modeling the seat-tube binder ring as a thin extruded ring with a cross-bolt. Create the side hydraulic port with a small horizontal cylinder and hex fitting. Build the saddle rail clamp using nested boxes and cylinders, and model the parallel steel cradle rails as swept or bent profiles supporting an extruded, tapered wedge representing the padded saddle shell. Define a prismatic joint between the outer and inner tubes, and a revolute joint for the saddle tilt adjust.
